math_status: requested recurrence and componentwise envelope independently derived as correct

state_and_units.not_actual_q: q=Gamma*s is a different coordinate; do not multiply Gamma twice
state_and_units.if_state_already_actual_modal_q: Use omega_r^2*S_sr/1000 instead of B_sr*omega_r^2/1000, with compatible modal state/input; this contract uses unit s.

target_model.input: same frozen ag/interpolation/grid/end continuation as target reference
target_model.no_target_state_input: Ac/b depend on omega,zeta_c,h and input, not xstar
target_model.variable_h: Use ordered transition products or a separately derived varying-step contract; Ac^k assumes a constant step.

prediction: same frozen T1/T2 states including velocity, assembled from baseline s/sdot,z/zdot,w/wdot

defect_and_error.initial: e[0]=0 for matched zero IC; otherwise retain Ac^n*e[0]
defect_and_error.defect_must_be_full_state: Do not replace exact two-component discrete defect by h times a continuous residual without deriving the input-integration relation.

propagator_envelope.required_order: matrix power first, entry then absolute value; not scalar diagonal powers and not powers of abs(Ac)

underdamped_analytic_entries.critical_or_overdamped: use stable corresponding matrix exponential/formulas, not the underdamped square root

propagator_envelope.initial_uncertainty: If bounded nonzero initial error, add K11[n]*abs(e_s0)+K12[n]*abs(e_v0).
propagator_envelope.avoid_abs_matrix_recursion: abs(Ac)^k gives a valid but no tighter propagation than abs(Ac^k), and can grow for stable oscillators; do not report it as the specified tighter envelope.

floor_envelope.other_outputs: This displacement-row formula is for fixed elastic output; do not automatically reuse for damping/velocity outputs.

comparison_to_coth.dominance: No automatic domination between discrete defect and coth bounds.
comparison_to_coth.optional_min_rule: Euse[n]=min(Edisc[n],Ecoth) only if both bound the same target/predictor/grid with compatible numerical-error control
comparison_to_coth.freeze: min rule before candidate truth is inspected
comparison_to_coth.report: both original widths, combined width, validity status, and computation costs

numerical_guarantee_levels.algebra: exact in ideal discrete arithmetic for specified Ac/b
numerical_guarantee_levels.continuous_at_grid: exact piecewise-input transition coincides with continuous model sampled states
numerical_guarantee_levels.between_grid: not certified by sampled peak interval alone
numerical_guarantee_levels.floating: Ac/b evaluation, cancellation in defect, powers and convolution need error enclosures for strict numerical guarantees
numerical_guarantee_levels.FFT: Use padded linear convolution, not circular wraparound; roundoff negative artifacts cannot be clipped into a claimed rigorous nonnegative bound without an error allowance.
numerical_guarantee_levels.uncontrolled_FP: Label computed envelope and empirically test coverage; do not call strict finite-precision certificate.

workflow: compute candidate Ac/b and prediction defect only
propagate absolute defects through absolute entries of complete Ac powers
sum floor envelopes, form local peak intervals, freeze CSV
only then read independently generated candidate target states for coverage/width audit

cost_and_fairness.reuse: K sequences shared by waves/methods with same mode/h/target; mode error envelopes reused across floors
cost_and_fairness.signed_reconstruction: signed recurrence/convolution gives exact candidate correction in this model; classify as full target reconstruction, not free prediction.
